Container.Name: arc-relay

Branch.TagDescription: v0.1.1 - OAuth re-registration fix, dashboard /connect link fix, Sentry DSN docs

Container.Overview: Arc Relay is a management proxy for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It sits between your AI tools (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) and your MCP servers, providing a single authenticated endpoint that handles Docker container lifecycle, health monitoring, OAuth flows, access control, and multi-transport proxying. Manage all your MCP servers from one web UI. (Formerly MCP Wrangler)

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Arc Relay web UI and API proxy.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite database. Upgrading from MCP Wrangler? Point this at your existing /mnt/user/appdata/mcp-wrangler directory.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket for managing MCP server containers (stdio and HTTP server types).

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored credentials (OAuth tokens, API keys, env vars). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. IMPORTANT: Do not lose this key - encrypted data becomes unreadable without it. Upgrading from MCP Wrangler? Use the same key as before.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Signs web UI session cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. If omitted, a random secret is generated on each restart (sessions won't survive restarts).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the admin web UI account (only used on first run to create the admin user).

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Path to SQLite database inside the container. Upgrading from MCP Wrangler? Set to /data/mcp-wrangler.db or rename your DB file.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: External URL for OAuth callbacks and install scripts (e.g., https://mcp.yourdomain.com). Required for OAuth and invite token onboarding. Leave blank for http://localhost:PORT.

Config.Name: Sentry DSN
Config.Description: Sentry DSN for error tracking. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: LLM API Key
Config.Description: Anthropic API key for LLM-powered tool context optimization. Enables the 'Run Optimization' feature on server detail pages to compress tool descriptions and reduce token usage. Get a key at https://console.anthropic.com/. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: LLM Model
Config.Description: Model to use for tool optimization. Default is claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (fast and cheap). Only change if you want to use a different Anthropic model.
